title: Dataverse Early-Bound TypeScript Generator config
description: Tool settings and saved projects for the Dataverse Early-Bound TypeScript Generator. dataverse-early-bound-typescript-generator-config.json holds the defaults bundled at build time; values saved in the tool are kept in PPTB's per-tool settings in the same shape.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor validation. Ignored by the tool.

deleteOrphanedFiles.description: Delete files in the output folders that the current selection no longer generates. When true, Generate deletes them permanently after the user confirms the list; when false, they're only reported. Shown on the Settings panel's Generate & files tab and as a switch in Preview and generate.

confirmBeforeGenerate.description: Ask for confirmation before Generate writes files, naming the output folder and how many files will be created and overwritten. Overwrites can't be undone. Shown on the Settings panel's Generate & files tab.

skipDuplicateIdentifiers.description: Don't write generated files that declare a name more than once (two choice labels that become the same enum member name), since TypeScript won't compile them. When false, they're written and only reported. Shown on the Settings panel's Generate & files tab.

renameDuplicateIdentifiers.description: Rename later duplicate enum members (two choice labels that become the same name) to <Name>_<Value>, for example InProgress_700970000, so the generated files compile. When false, the output matches dataverse-gen and the files are reported as having duplicate identifiers. Shown on the Settings panel's Generate & files tab and as a switch in Preview and generate.

generateTemplates.description: Write dataverse-gen's EJS templates to the project's templateRoot (_templates by default) on Generate, overwriting edited copies, like dataverse-gen eject. When false, Generate doesn't write them and leaves existing copies untouched. Shown on the Settings panel's Generate & files tab.

projects.description: Projects created with the New Project dialog.

isoDateTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC, as written by Date.toISOString().

general.description: Settings on the General tab: how the tool itself behaves. Missing or mistyped keys fall back to the defaults; numbers are rounded and clamped to their range.

showProjectLoadedNotification.description: Show the "Project loaded" notification after a project opens.

showPreviewReadyNotification.description: Show the "Preview ready" notification after a preview.

showGenerationCompleteNotification.description: Show the "Generation complete" notification after Generate.

recentProjectCount.description: Recent projects offered on the Project card. 0 hides the list.

selectionRowLimit.description: Rows shown at most in each Select table (tables, actions, functions); refine the search to see others.

projectDefaults.description: Options a new project starts with: applied when a project folder without .dataverse-gen.json is opened. Projects that already have one keep their own values. Missing or mistyped keys fall back to dataverse-gen's defaults.

outputRoot.description: Output folder, relative to the project folder. Written to a new project's output.outputRoot. A blank value falls back to the default.

generateEntityTypes.description: Generate an early-bound interface per table for dataverse-ify. Written to a new project's generateEntityTypes.

generateFormContext.description: Generate a typed <Table>FormContext interface per table for form scripts. Written to a new project's generateFormContext.

generateIndex.description: Generate an index.ts that re-exports every generated file. Written to a new project's generateIndex.

customEnumTemplate.description: Default for a project's custom enum template (pptbEarlyBoundGenerator.customEnumTemplate in its .dataverse-gen.json). Unlike the other options, it's only filled in when the project's file has no value, and never replaces one. Shown on the Settings panel's Options tab; each project's value is on the Options card.

project.description: A saved project. The tool skips entries missing id, name, location or createdOn, and fills in description, version and modifiedOn when absent.

name.description: Project name. Unique among saved projects, ignoring case.

location.description: Absolute path of the project folder, usually the one with package.json and .dataverse-gen.json.

version.description: Project version. Starts at 1.0.0 and gets a patch bump when a Generate run adds files or stops producing ones the previous run did.

modifiedOn.description: When a Generate run last added or dropped files. Defaults to createdOn.

lastGeneratedFiles.description: Output files the last Generate run produced, relative to the output folder with forward slashes. Absent until the project is first generated.
